title: [DOC] Fix indent in `ecosystem.rst` and `formatoptions.rst`
body:
Presently the format-specific IO documentation is parsed by sphinx as block quotes due to indents in `io_formats.py`.
A similar issue is also in `ecosystem.rst`.

Maybe these are not intentional, so I would like to suggest to make it "normal" in the present MR.
With this, e.g., the IO page will look like below, without gray background:

![image](/uploads/a1513b72b7dacf8dd15bdcc4425d76ba/image.png){width=825 height=306}
author: yuzie007

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Thanks a lot @yuzie007 , indeed that's much better!

thread.actionability_reasoning: Pure acknowledgment/social comment with no suggested code changes.
